description: Core table storing all compliance violations and regulatory breaches

columns.SOE_ID: Employee SOE ID who committed or is associated with the violation
columns.VIOLATION_TYPE: Type of violation (AML, KYC, Conflict of Interest, Data Privacy, etc.)
columns.SEVERITY: Severity level: Low, Medium, High, Critical
columns.STATUS: Current status: Open, In Progress, Closed, Escalated
columns.FINANCIAL_IMPACT: Financial penalty or loss amount in USD
